pages.title: Three Cats Building a Snowman with a Ladder Coloring Page
pages.description: Three cats build a snowman in this printable coloring page, with one standing on a ladder while the others reach toward its large rounded body. The snowman has circular eyes and buttons beneath a small open smile. This winter coloring sheet combines broad snow and fur sections with smaller ladder rungs, scattered blocks, and rounded ground details.

pages.title: Hello Kitty in a Winter Coat with Snowflakes Coloring Page
pages.description: Hello Kitty stands among falling snowflakes in this printable coloring page, wearing a fluffy hooded coat with a bow at the neck and trimmed cuffs. Her familiar head bow carries small snowflake motifs, echoed across the buttoned coat. The coloring sheet pairs broad clothing spaces with narrow bow sections, scalloped trim, and branching snowflake shapes.

pages.title: Cats Gathered Around a Giant Cat Snowman Coloring Page
pages.description: Cats gather around a giant cat snowman in this printable coloring page, with one perched on its head above a fringed scarf and stick arms. Smaller striped cats fill the snowy foreground, while others peek from a house window. The winter coloring sheet includes falling snow, pointed trees, broad scarf panels, and small whisker and tail details.

pages.title: Girl Wrapped in a Blanket with a Sleeping Cat Coloring Page
pages.description: A girl sits wrapped in a patterned blanket in this printable coloring page, with a sleeping cat beside her and snow falling beyond the window. String lights, snowflake curtains, and distant houses frame the winter view. A heater and steaming paw-print mug add smaller shapes beside broad blanket folds and rows of geometric patterns on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Gingerbread Man Relaxing in a Patterned Mug Coloring Page
pages.description: A smiling gingerbread man relaxes inside a patterned mug in this printable coloring page, resting both arms on the rim above broad swirling liquid shapes. Icing eyebrows, wavy wrist decorations, and a round button detail the cookie. The large handle, zigzag bands, and row of circles divide the mug into open sections on this holiday coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pink Panther Sitting Between Two Snowmen Coloring Page
pages.description: The Pink Panther sits between two snowmen in this printable coloring page, wearing a zigzag winter sweater beneath large snowflakes and rows of snowy evergreens. Both snowmen have carrot noses, scarves, and pom-pom hats, with twig arms raised. Broad sweater and snow sections contrast with smaller ribbing, whiskers, tree branches, and snowflake points on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Christmas Tree Coloring Page
pages.description: A decorated Christmas tree fills this printable coloring page, topped with a large star and hung with round ornaments, bows, and sweeping garland bands. Three wrapped presents sit beneath the branches, with ribbon loops and box panels adding smaller sections around the broad tree shapes.

pages.title: Santa Claus Coloring Page
pages.description: Santa Claus carries a sack over one shoulder in this printable coloring page, wearing a belted coat, a floppy hat, and tall fur-trimmed boots. His long beard and curved moustache frame a closed smile. The sack folds, square buckle, soft cuffs, and relaxed mitten distinguish the clothing and accessories.

pages.title: Christmas Reindeer Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features a Christmas reindeer standing on four hooves, with branching antlers, a floppy Santa hat, and a bell hanging from its collar. Two small trees sit behind the animal on a curved ground line. Broad body areas contrast with the collar studs, hoof divisions, and hat trim.

pages.title: Christmas Elf Coloring Page
pages.description: A Christmas elf holds a large ribboned present in this printable coloring page, wearing a pointed hat, a belted tunic, striped stockings, and curled boots. Both hands wrap around the sides of the box. The bow loops, jagged tunic hem, pointed ears, and simple hair sections provide distinct enclosed shapes.

pages.title: Gingerbread Man Coloring Page
pages.description: A smiling gingerbread man appears on this printable coloring page with a bow tie, three round buttons, and wavy icing bands across its arms and feet. The cookie has a rounded head and two broad legs. Large open sections inside the icing borders keep the face, bow, and body clearly separated.

pages.title: Gingerbread House Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows a gingerbread house with peppermint roof decorations, candy-cane porch pillars, three arched windows, and icing draped along its pitched roof. Gumdrop shapes line the base beside the front steps. The door, chimney, candy stripes, and windowpanes divide the house into a mix of broad and smaller sections.

pages.title: Christmas Stocking Coloring Page
pages.description: A Christmas stocking hangs from a loop in this printable coloring page, with a candy cane and a ribboned present tucked inside its fluffy cuff. A large outlined snowflake decorates the front above wavy bands. The rounded heel, striped cane, gift box, and bow offer separate shapes within the simple composition.

pages.title: Christmas Ornament Coloring Page
pages.description: A large Christmas ornament fills this printable coloring page, with a ribbon bow above its hanging loop and rows of outlined stars across curved decorative bands. The bauble has a scalloped cap and a broad round body. Its repeating stars and open stripes provide smaller sections without adding a detailed background.

pages.title: Christmas Wreath Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features a Christmas wreath formed from pointed holly leaves and round berries, with two bells hanging beneath a large ribbon bow. The center remains open and undecorated. Leaf veins, bell rims, berry clusters, and pointed ribbon tails create distinct details around the circular outline.

pages.title: Candy Cane Coloring Page
pages.description: Two striped candy canes cross behind a large bow on this printable coloring page, with their curved hooks pointing outward above the ribbon loops and tails. Both canes continue to rounded ends below the knot. The broad stripes and folded bow sections create clear areas within a plain white background.

pages.title: Nativity Scene Coloring Page
pages.description: Mary and Joseph kneel beside baby Jesus in this printable coloring page, with a manger beneath a stable roof and a large star overhead. Mary folds her hands while Joseph holds a curved staff. Their robes, head coverings, the manger supports, and its pointed straw shapes add detail around the central family.

pages.title: Christmas Nutcracker Coloring Page
pages.description: A Christmas nutcracker stands upright in this printable coloring page, wearing a tall crown, fringed shoulder decorations, a belted jacket, and boots with round buttons. Curled hair frames its moustache and pointed beard. The straight arms, open hands, horizontal jacket fastenings, and separate trouser legs create a clear full-length figure.

pages.title: Halloween Pumpkin Coloring Page
pages.description: A carved Halloween pumpkin fills this printable coloring page, with triangular eyes, a small nose opening, and a broad smile interrupted by square teeth. A curved stem, leaf, and curling vine rise above the rounded body. The carved openings remain unfilled, while vertical grooves divide the pumpkin into broad sections.

pages.title: Halloween Ghost Coloring Page
pages.description: A friendly Halloween ghost spreads its draped sheet arms on this printable coloring page, with a curved smile and a wavy hem beneath its rounded head. Long fold lines run through the body and sleeves. The plain background keeps the floating silhouette prominent, with large white areas between the folds.

pages.title: Halloween Witch Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows a Halloween witch holding a broom beside her long dress, with one hand on her hip and buckled shoes below. Her pointed hat has a band and buckle, and a clasp joins her cape. The laced bodice, outlined hair, broom ties, and bristles add smaller details.

pages.title: Haunted House Coloring Page
pages.description: A haunted house leans beneath pointed roofs in this printable coloring page, with a crooked chimney, arched windows, front steps, and a bare tree beside it. Curved roof tiles and scattered brick shapes break up the walls. The windows remain unfilled, and a few stones and grass tufts mark the ground.

pages.title: Halloween Bat Coloring Page
pages.description: A Halloween bat spreads two complete wings across this printable coloring page, with large pointed ears, a rounded furry body, and two small feet beneath it. Long wing supports divide the open membranes into separate panels. The closed smile, small nose, and simple fur outlines keep the character clear against the empty background.

pages.title: Halloween Skeleton Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features a Halloween skeleton standing with both hands on its hips, showing an outlined skull, ribcage, spine, pelvis, and complete legs. Separate finger and toe bones add smaller sections around the broad limb shapes. The skull openings remain white, and the bent elbows create a clear standing pose.

pages.title: Trick or Treat Coloring Page
pages.description: A child dressed as a superhero holds a pumpkin bucket and wrapped candy in this printable coloring page, with a cape, eye mask, and belted costume. Both shoes remain visible beneath the trouser legs. The bucket handle, carved pumpkin face, blank chest emblem, and candy wrapper add details around the full figure.

pages.title: Candy Corn Coloring Page
pages.description: Three candy-corn sweets overlap on this printable coloring page, with one large piece in front and two taller pieces standing behind its rounded triangular outline. Two curved dividing lines mark three bands on each sweet. The simple arrangement leaves broad white sections and includes no characters, lettering, or background objects.

pages.title: Thanksgiving Turkey Coloring Page
pages.description: A Thanksgiving turkey stands beneath a pilgrim-style hat in this printable coloring page, with a fan of broad tail feathers and two wings at its sides. A long wattle hangs beside the curved beak. The hat buckle, feather bands, short legs, and outlined toes add details around the rounded body.

pages.title: Thanksgiving Cornucopia Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows a Thanksgiving cornucopia filled with a pumpkin, corn, grapes, an apple, and a pear spilling from its broad woven opening. The horn curves upward to a narrow tip. Braided edging, basket strips, corn kernels, fruit stems, and leaves provide distinct patterns around the larger harvest shapes.

pages.title: Thanksgiving Dinner Coloring Page
pages.description: A Thanksgiving dinner fills this printable coloring page with a roast turkey, pumpkin pie, two food bowls, and candles arranged across a cloth-covered round table. A flower and leaves rise from a pumpkin centerpiece behind the platter. The pie crust, candle holders, bowls, and hanging cloth folds create separate tabletop details.

pages.title: Pumpkin Pie Coloring Page
pages.description: A pumpkin pie with one wedge removed appears on this printable coloring page, with the separate slice resting on a plate beneath a swirl of cream. The crimped crust outlines both pieces, and the cut edges reveal broad layers. A simple tabletop line separates the two large food shapes from the empty background.

pages.title: Easter Bunny Coloring Page
pages.description: An Easter bunny sits holding a large decorated egg in this printable coloring page, with long upright ears, a neck bow, and two broad hind feet. Its forepaws curl around the egg beside bands of circles and zigzags. A small tail and a few grass tufts complete the simple seated scene.

pages.title: Easter Egg Coloring Page
pages.description: A single Easter egg fills this printable coloring page, decorated with broad curved bands, round dots, zigzags, and a row of large five-petal flowers. The tall rounded outline keeps the pattern contained within one prominent shape. Empty spaces between the bands leave room around the smaller circles and flower centers.

pages.title: Easter Basket Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features an Easter basket holding three patterned eggs beneath an arched handle topped with a large bow and two pointed ribbon tails. Broad woven strips cross the basket below its rounded rim. Flowers and grass tufts sit beside the base, adding simple shapes around the egg patterns.

pages.title: Easter Chick Coloring Page
pages.description: An Easter chick emerges from a cracked shell in this printable coloring page, with two spread wings, small feet below, and the upper shell resting overhead. A single flower grows beside the lower shell. The fluffy outline, broad eggshell pieces, leaf shapes, and short grass marks create a simple hatching scene.

pages.title: Easter Egg Hunt Coloring Page
pages.description: A boy searches for Easter eggs in this printable coloring page, holding a woven basket in one hand and raising a decorated egg in the other. Three more eggs sit among grass and flowers around his shoes. A tree, bushes, shirt collar, shorts, and basket pattern add recognizable garden and clothing details.

pages.title: Easter Cross Coloring Page
pages.description: A large Easter cross stands above lilies in this printable coloring page, with a long cloth draped over both arms and hanging down beside the upright. Curved folds divide the fabric into broad sections. The open flower petals, outlined stamens, pointed leaves, and sparse ground line keep the cross prominent.

pages.title: Valentine Heart Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page centers on a large Valentine heart with a scalloped border, a ribbon bow at its lower point, and four smaller surrounding hearts. The main heart remains empty inside its double outline. Broad bow loops and pointed ribbon tails create separate sections below the curved border.

pages.title: Cupid Coloring Page
pages.description: Cupid stands holding a bow and heart-tipped arrow in this printable coloring page, with two feathered wings, a gathered tunic, and sandals on both feet. The arrow points down across the clothing while the curved bow rests beside the figure. Hair curls, fabric folds, straps, and feather sections provide smaller details.

pages.title: Valentine Teddy Bear Coloring Page
pages.description: A seated Valentine teddy bear hugs a large heart in this printable coloring page, with both forepaws wrapped around its sides and rounded feet below. Separate oval pads mark the paws, and a broad muzzle surrounds the nose and smile. The empty heart and open body sections dominate the simple composition.

pages.title: Valentine Rose Coloring Page
pages.description: A single Valentine rose rises above a ribbon bow in this printable coloring page, with layered petals, two serrated leaves, and small hearts beside the bloom. The stem remains visible above and below the bow knot. Leaf veins, curled inner petals, and pointed ribbon tails add detail without a surrounding scene.

pages.title: Leprechaun Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features a leprechaun holding a three-leaf shamrock beside a pot of coins, wearing a buckle hat, waistcoat, bow tie, and buckled shoes. One hand rests on his hip above knee-length trousers. Coat pockets, striped stockings, outlined beard sections, and stacked coins distinguish the outfit and nearby objects.

pages.title: Shamrock Coloring Page
pages.description: A traditional shamrock fills this printable coloring page with exactly three heart-shaped leaflets meeting above a short curved stem, all framed by a bold outer contour. The open leaf interiors contain no decorative patterns. Its simple connected silhouette stands alone against the white background, leaving three broad areas around the central join.

pages.title: Rainbow and Pot of Gold Coloring Page
pages.description: A complete rainbow arches behind a pot of gold on this printable coloring page, with stacked coins at the rim and three shamrocks around the base. One end meets the ground while the other disappears behind the pot. Open rainbow bands, rounded handles, coin edges, and small grass tufts divide the scene.

pages.title: 4th of July Fireworks Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Fourth of July fireworks above a waving American flag, with a small town and pointed church roof along the bottom. Three large bursts contain outlined stars and long curved sparks. The flag stripes, star shapes, rooftops, and distant bushes add smaller sections beneath the prominent fireworks.

pages.title: Patriotic Eagle Coloring Page
pages.description: A patriotic bald eagle perches on a rock in this printable coloring page, with folded wings, curved talons, and an American flag waving beside its head. Layered feather outlines run down the body and tail. The hooked beak, flag stripes, outlined stars, and angular rock panels provide distinct enclosed shapes.

pages.title: Happy New Year Coloring Page
pages.description: Two children celebrate beneath a large clock in this printable coloring page, wearing pointed party hats and raising glasses between fireworks, stars, and curled streamers. The boy wears a bow tie, and the girl has a flared dress. Clock tick marks, hat patterns, clothing panels, and glass outlines add separate details.

pages.title: Mother's Day Flowers Coloring Page
pages.description: A Mother's Day bouquet fills this printable coloring page with roses, tulips, and daisies wrapped in folded paper and tied with a large ribbon bow. A blank heart-shaped tag hangs beside the knot. Layered petals, pointed leaves, visible stems, and broad wrapping panels give the arrangement varied enclosed shapes.

pages.title: Happy Father's Day Coloring Page
pages.description: A father kneels beside his child in this printable coloring page as they hold a ribboned gift between them, with grass and bushes behind their shoes. Both wear short-sleeved shirts and sneakers. The father's folded trouser legs, the child's shorts, gift-box panels, and bow loops distinguish the family scene.

pages.title: Hanukkah Menorah Coloring Page
pages.description: A Hanukkah menorah holds nine candles in this printable coloring page, with four on each side of a raised central shamash and curved branches below. Each candle has an outlined flame above its wax edge. The rounded holders, long stems, broad base, and separate branch channels create a balanced open design.

pages.title: Hanukkah Dreidel Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features a Hanukkah dreidel with a long handle, blank side panels, and a pointed base, with three round coins arranged nearby. The tilted top and visible corner give the spinning toy a three-dimensional shape. Broad empty faces contrast with the thinner coin edges and simple curved ground line.

pages.title: Kwanzaa Kinara Coloring Page
pages.description: A Kwanzaa kinara holds seven candles in this printable coloring page, with three on either side of a taller central candle above a decorated bowl-shaped stand. Outlined flames and curved wax edges top each candle. Triangular border patterns, the rounded pedestal, and a woven mat add smaller details beneath the candle row.

pages.title: Diwali Diya Coloring Page
pages.description: A Diwali diya carries a large outlined flame in this printable coloring page, with a flower and curling leaf patterns decorating its broad rounded bowl. A simple rangoli-style floral arrangement spreads beneath the base. The open flame, rim, petal shapes, dots, and curved ornament lines create separate areas without a detailed background.

pages.title: Eid Mubarak Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page presents an Eid Mubarak lantern beneath a crescent moon and three stars, with a small mosque and two minarets in the distance. A chain joins the lantern's top ring above its domed cap. Arched window panels, curved lower trim, and a pointed hanging ornament distinguish the large lantern.

pages.title: Chinese New Year Dragon Coloring Page
pages.description: A Chinese New Year dragon winds beneath three lanterns in this printable coloring page, with an ornate head, branching horns, long whiskers, and a continuous patterned body. Overlapping scales and hanging fabric panels follow the dragon's curves toward its flared tail. Lantern ribs, tassels, and outlined facial decorations add smaller festival details.

pages.title: Day of the Dead Sugar Skull Coloring Page
pages.description: A Day of the Dead sugar skull fills this printable coloring page with floral eye borders, leafy curls, a heart-shaped nose opening, and outlined teeth. A large flower decorates the forehead above smaller cheek blossoms. Open sockets and broad skull sections separate the decorative petals, leaves, and curved forehead marks.

pages.title: Mardi Gras Mask Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features a Mardi Gras mask with two eye openings, three large feathers, curved decorative lines, and a strand of beads hanging below. A central ornament sits between the brows beneath the feathers. Broad feather sections, rounded beads, and open mask panels offer different shapes within the complete silhouette.
